procedures.title: Parking brake lever assembly (Corvette): remove and install
steps: (Removal) Put the parking brake lever fully released.
notes: See figure 20 in the manual for the Corvette parking brake system layout.
Center and rear cable procedures on this page are for Chevrolet, Chevelle, Camaro and Chevy II and are not included.
